blocks.text: 106-darsda asosiy mantiqni ko'rdik: **in** — ichida, **at** — nuqtada, **on** — yuzada. Kundalik nutqda esa ko'p iboralar **tayyor holda** ishlatiladi: **in** bed, **at** home, **at** work, **on** the bus, **in** a car, **on** the second floor. Ularning ba'zilari mantiqqa mos keladi, ba'zilarini shunchaki yodlash kerak. O'zbekchada bularning hammasi yana `-da` bilan aytiladi: to'shak**da**, uy**da**, ish**da**, avtobus**da**, mashina**da** — shuning uchun aynan shu iboralarda xato ko'p bo'ladi.
Artiklsiz: in bed, at home, at work

Bir guruh iboralarda **artikl ishlatilmaydi**, chunki gap binoning o'zi haqida emas, u yerdagi odatiy faoliyat haqida: **in bed** — uxlash yoki dam olish uchun yotibdi, **in hospital** — bemor sifatida davolanyapti (British English), **in prison** — qamoqda. Xuddi shunday: **at home**, **at work**, **at school**, **at university**, **at college**. **at home** — «o'z uyida», **in the house** esa «bino ichida» degan ma'no beradi: It's cold **in the house** — Uy ichi sovuq.

items.text: Dad is still **at work**, but Mum is **at home**.
The baby has been **in bed** since seven.

blocks.text: at the station, at a party, at Aziz's

**at** biror **faoliyat** bo'ladigan joy bilan ishlatiladi: **at** the station, **at** the airport, **at** the cinema, **at** the bank. Tadbirlar ham shunday: **at** a party, **at** a concert, **at** a wedding, **at** a football match, **at** a meeting, **at** a conference. Kimningdir uyi yoki ish joyi — **at** + egalik `'s`: **at** Aziz's (Azizlar**nikida**), **at** my grandmother's (buvim**nikida**), **at** the doctor's (shifokor qabulida), **at** the hairdresser's (sartaroshxonada). «house» yoki «shop» so'zi odatda aytilmaydi (`'s` — 64-dars).

items.text: We met lots of new people **at the wedding**.
Sorry I'm late — I was **at the bank**.

blocks.text: Bino nomi bilan ko'pincha ikkala predlog ham mumkin, lekin ma'no biroz farq qiladi: We were **at the cinema** — kinoga borgan edik (film ko'rish — faoliyat); It was cold **in the cinema** — kinoteatr **ichi** sovuq edi (bino ichi). Shahar va mamlakat bilan esa doim **in**: **in** Tashkent, **in** England («at Tashkent» emas).
on the bus, but in a car

Transport bilan predlog uning hajmiga bog'liq. Katta jamoat transportida turib yurish mumkin — xuddi yuzada turgandek, shuning uchun **on**: **on** the bus, **on** the train, **on** a plane, **on** a ship, **on** the metro. Engil mashina va taksida esa faqat o'tirasiz — uning **ichidasiz**, shuning uchun **in**: **in** a car, **in** a taxi. Velosiped, mototsikl, ot — ustiga minasiz: **on** a bike, **on** a horse (106-dars).

rows: **on** the left / right, **on** a farm, **on** the way

items.text: I lost my gloves **on the bus**.
We waited **in the car** while Dad went into the shop.
items.translation: Dadam do'konga kirganda biz **mashinada** kutib turdik.

items.text: The toilets are **on the left**, past the lifts.

blocks.text: Qavatlar: Britaniyada ko'chaga teng qavat — **ground floor**, undan keyingisi — **first floor**. Ya'ni inglizlarning **first floor** i — bizning ikkinchi qavat, **second floor** — uchinchi qavat. Qavat bilan doim **on**: **on** the ground floor, **on** the top floor.
in a photo, in the newspaper, in the middle

Yana bir guruh **in** bilan: tasvir va matn ichidagi narsa — **in** a photo, **in** a picture, **in** the mirror, **in** a book, **in** the newspaper, **in** a letter (lekin sahifa — **on** page 5). Keng joylar — **in** the sky, **in** the world, **in** the country (qishloq joyda, shahar tashqarisida). O'rta — **in the middle** (of): **in the middle** of the room, **in the middle** of the night.

items.text: You look very young **in** this picture.
There was a photo of our street **in** the local newspaper.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «at the bed» → **in bed**; «in home» / «at the home» → **at home**; «in the bus» → **on the bus**; «on the car» → **in the car**; «in the second floor» → **on the second floor**; «in the party» → **at the party**; «on the photo» → **in the photo**; «at Tashkent» → **in Tashkent**.
Transport uchun oddiy test: ichida **tik turib yura olasizmi**? Ha (avtobus, poyezd, samolyot) — **on**. Faqat o'tirasizmi (mashina, taksi) — **in**.

Bog'lanish: go to work, go home, go to school (artiklsiz) — 71-dars; in / at / on ning asosiy ma'nolari — 106-dars; harakat: go **to**, arrive **in / at**, get **to** — 108-dars; egalik `'s` — 64-dars.

**in** a photo, **in** a book, **in** the newspaper
**at** a party, **at** a concert, **at** a wedding
**in** the sky, **in** the world, **in** the middle

examples.title: **in bed**, **in hospital**, **in prison**
examples.description: Artiklsiz iboralar: **in bed** (to'shakda, yotibdi), **in hospital** (kasalxonada, davolanyapti — British English), **in prison** (qamoqda).

sentences.text: It's ten o'clock and Bekzod is still **in bed**!
sentences.translation: Soat o'n bo'ldi, Bekzod esa hali ham **to'shakda** yotibdi!

sentences.text: My grandfather is **in hospital** with heart problems.
sentences.translation: Bobom yurak xastaligi bilan **kasalxonada** yotibdi.

sentences.text: I don't like reading **in bed** — I always fall asleep.
sentences.translation: **To'shakda** kitob o'qishni yoqtirmayman — doim uxlab qolaman.

sentences.text: How long was Madina **in hospital** after the accident?
sentences.translation: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin Madina **kasalxonada** qancha yotdi?

sentences.text: The man who stole the car is now **in prison**.
sentences.translation: Mashinani o'g'irlagan odam hozir **qamoqda**.

sentences.text: Stay **in bed** for a few days and drink plenty of water.
sentences.translation: Bir necha kun **to'shakda** yoting va ko'p suv iching.

sentences.text: Tom isn't **in hospital** himself — he works there as a doctor.
sentences.translation: Tomning o'zi **kasalxonada yotgani** yo'q — u yerda shifokor bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Were you **in bed** when I called last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qilganimda **yotgan edingizmi**?

sentences.text: After the operation, Dilnoza had to stay **in hospital** for two weeks.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin Dilnoza ikki hafta **kasalxonada** qolishiga to'g'ri keldi.

sentences.text: The children were already **in bed**, so we talked quietly in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Bolalar allaqachon **yotib qolgan** edi, shuning uchun oshxonada sekin gaplashdik.

examples.title: **at home**, **at work**, **at school**
examples.description: Kundalik joylar — **at** va artiklsiz: at home, at work, at school, at university, at college. O'zbekchada: uy**da**, ish**da**, maktab**da**.

sentences.text: Is your mum **at home**? — No, she's **at work**.
sentences.translation: Oying **uyda**mi? — Yo'q, u **ishda**.

sentences.text: My little brother is **at school** until three o'clock.
sentences.translation: Ukam soat uchgacha **maktabda**.

sentences.text: Sarah studies medicine **at university** in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Sara Edinburgdagi **universitetda** tibbiyot o'qiydi.

sentences.text: I left my laptop **at work**, so I can't check my email.
sentences.translation: Noutbukimni **ishda** qoldirdim, shuning uchun pochtamni tekshira olmayman.

sentences.text: We stayed **at home** last night and watched a film.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun **uyda** qolib, film ko'rdik.

sentences.text: What did the children learn **at school** today? — Fractions, I think.
sentences.translation: Bolalar bugun **maktabda** nima o'rganishdi? — Kasrlarni, shekilli.

sentences.text: Aziz met his wife when they were both **at college**.
sentences.translation: Aziz rafiqasi bilan ikkalasi **kollejda** o'qiyotganda tanishgan.

sentences.text: Nobody was **at home** when the parcel arrived.
sentences.translation: Posilka kelganda **uyda** hech kim yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Do you have lunch **at work**, or do you go home?
sentences.translation: Tushlikni **ishda** qilasizmi yoki uyga borasizmi?

sentences.text: During the day the parents are **at work** and the children are **at school**, so the house is empty.
sentences.translation: Kunduzi ota-ona **ishda**, bolalar **maktabda**, shuning uchun uy bo'm-bo'sh.

examples.title: **at the station**, **at a party**, **at a concert**
examples.description: Faoliyat yoki tadbir bo'ladigan joy — **at**: at the station, at the airport, at the cinema, at a party, at a concert, at a wedding, at a meeting.

sentences.text: I'll meet you **at the station** at six.
sentences.translation: Sizni soat oltida **vokzalda** kutib olaman.

sentences.text: We had to wait three hours **at the airport** because of the fog.
sentences.translation: Tuman sababli **aeroportda** uch soat kutishga to'g'ri keldi.

sentences.text: Did you have a good time **at the party**?
sentences.translation: **Ziyofatda** yaxshi dam oldingizmi?

sentences.text: There were over five hundred guests **at** my cousin's **wedding**.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchamning **to'yida** besh yuzdan ortiq mehmon bor edi.

sentences.text: James was **at a football match** when his wife called.
sentences.translation: Rafiqasi qo'ng'iroq qilganda Jeyms **futbol o'yinida** edi.

sentences.text: I saw Madina **at the concert** last night — she looked great.
sentences.translation: Kecha **konsertda** Madinani ko'rdim — u ajoyib ko'rinardi.

sentences.text: Sorry, Mr Karimov is **at a meeting** at the moment.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, janob Karimov hozir **yig'ilishda**.

sentences.text: Bekzod gave a talk **at a conference** in London last spring.
sentences.translation: O'tgan bahorda Bekzod Londondagi **konferensiyada** ma'ruza qildi.

sentences.text: We were **at the cinema** when the lights went out.
sentences.translation: Chiroqlar o'chganda biz **kinoda** edik.

sentences.text: It was freezing **in** the theatre, but we enjoyed the play.
sentences.translation: Teatr **ichi** qahraton sovuq edi, lekin spektakl bizga yoqdi.

examples.title: **at** Aziz's, **at** the doctor's
examples.description: Kimningdir uyi yoki ish joyi — **at** + `'s`: at Aziz's (Azizlar**nikida**), at my grandmother's, at the doctor's, at the hairdresser's. «house», «shop» so'zlari odatda tushib qoladi.

sentences.text: We had dinner **at** Aziz's last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun **Azizlarnikida** kechki ovqat qildik.

sentences.text: The children are spending the weekend **at** their grandmother's.
sentences.translation: Bolalar dam olish kunlarini **buvisinikida** o'tkazyapti.

sentences.text: I was **at the dentist's** this morning, and my tooth still hurts.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **tish shifokorida** bo'ldim, tishim hali ham og'riyapti.

sentences.text: Where's Madina? — She's **at the hairdresser's**.
sentences.translation: Madina qayerda? — U **sartaroshxonada**.

sentences.text: Can I stay **at** your place tonight? I've lost my keys.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi **sizlarnikida** qolsam bo'ladimi? Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim.

sentences.text: Emma's coat is still **at** Sarah's — she forgot it after the party.
sentences.translation: Emmaning paltosi hali ham **Saralarnikida** — u ziyofatdan keyin uni unutib qoldirgan.

sentences.text: How long did you wait **at the doctor's**? — Almost an hour.
sentences.translation: **Shifokor qabulida** qancha kutdingiz? — Deyarli bir soat.

sentences.text: Every Friday the whole family meets **at** my parents'.
sentences.translation: Har juma butun oila **ota-onamnikida** yig'iladi.

sentences.text: Tom bought some fresh bread **at the baker's** on his way home.
sentences.translation: Tom uyga ketayotib **novvoyxonadan** yangi non oldi.

sentences.text: While I was **at** my uncle's in Samarkand, I helped him in his garden every day.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi **amakimnikida** bo'lganimda, har kuni unga bog'ida yordam berdim.

examples.title: **on** the bus / train / plane, but **in** a car / taxi
examples.description: Katta transport (ichida yurish mumkin) — **on**: on the bus, on the train, on a plane, on a ship. Kichik transport — **in**: in a car, in a taxi.

sentences.text: I usually read a book **on the bus**.
sentences.translation: Odatda **avtobusda** kitob o'qiyman.

sentences.text: There were no free seats **on the train**, so we stood all the way.
sentences.translation: **Poyezdda** bo'sh o'rin yo'q edi, shuning uchun butun yo'l tik turdik.

sentences.text: Aziz is **in a taxi** — he'll be here in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Aziz **taksida** — o'n daqiqadan keyin shu yerda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Have you ever slept **on a plane**?
sentences.translation: Hech **samolyotda** uxlaganmisiz?

sentences.text: The children always argue **in the car** on long journeys.
sentences.translation: Uzoq safarlarda bolalar **mashinada** doim janjallashadi.

sentences.text: Sarah met her husband **on a ship** sailing to Greece.
sentences.translation: Sara eri bilan Gretsiyaga suzayotgan **kemada** tanishgan.

sentences.text: Don't eat **on the metro** — it isn't allowed.
sentences.translation: **Metroda** ovqat yemang — bu mumkin emas.

sentences.text: I left my umbrella **in** Bekzod's **car** yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha soyabonimni Bekzodning **mashinasida** qoldirdim.

sentences.text: When the bus broke down, there were about forty passengers **on** it.
sentences.translation: Avtobus buzilib qolganda **unda** qirqqa yaqin yo'lovchi bor edi.

sentences.text: We went to Bukhara **on the fast train**, but we came back **in** my brother's **car**.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga **tezyurar poyezdda** bordik, qaytishda esa akamning **mashinasida** keldik.

examples.title: **on** the top floor, **on** the left, **on** the way
examples.description: Yana **on** bilan iboralar: on the ground / first / top floor (qavat), on the left / right, on a farm, on the way (yo'lda, ketayotib).

sentences.text: Our flat is **on the top floor**, and there's no lift.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz **eng yuqori qavatda**, lift esa yo'q.

sentences.text: The reception is **on the ground floor**, near the main entrance.
sentences.translation: Qabul bo'limi **birinchi qavatda**, asosiy kirish yaqinida.

sentences.text: In a British hotel, a room **on the first floor** is one floor above the street.
sentences.translation: Britaniya mehmonxonasida **first floor** dagi xona ko'chadan bir qavat yuqorida, ya'ni **ikkinchi qavatda** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The bank is **on the left**, just after the bridge.
sentences.translation: Bank ko'prikdan o'tgach, **chap tomonda**.

sentences.text: Take the second street **on the right**.
sentences.translation: **O'ng tomondagi** ikkinchi ko'chaga buriling.

sentences.text: Bekzod's uncle lives **on a farm** and keeps sheep and cows.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning amakisi **fermada** yashaydi, qo'y va sigir boqadi.

sentences.text: I'll buy some bread **on the way** home.
sentences.translation: Uyga ketayotib **yo'l-yo'lakay** non olaman.

sentences.text: Where are you? — **On my way** to the airport.
sentences.translation: Qayerdasiz? — Aeroportga **ketyapman**.

sentences.text: In Britain cars drive **on the left**, so be careful when you cross the road.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada mashinalar yo'lning **chap tomonida** yuradi, shuning uchun ko'chadan o'tayotganda ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: We stopped at a little café **on the way** to Samarkand and had the best samsa of our lives.
sentences.translation: Samarqand **yo'lida** kichik bir kafeda to'xtadik va hayotimizdagi eng mazali somsani yedik.

examples.title: **in** a photo, **in** the newspaper, **in** the middle
examples.description: **in** bilan turg'un iboralar: in a photo / picture / the mirror, in a book / newspaper / message, in the sky, in the world, in the country, in the middle (of).

sentences.text: Who's the woman **in** this photo? — It's my aunt.
sentences.translation: Bu **suratdagi** ayol kim? — Xolam.

sentences.text: I read an interesting article **in** the newspaper this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **gazetada** qiziqarli maqola o'qidim.

sentences.text: Look at the moon **in** the sky — it's huge tonight!
sentences.translation: **Osmondagi** oyga qarang — bugun juda katta!

sentences.text: Is Everest the highest mountain **in the world**? — Yes, it is.
sentences.translation: Everest **dunyodagi** eng baland tog'mi? — Ha.

sentences.text: There's a beautiful fountain **in the middle** of the square.
sentences.translation: Maydonning **o'rtasida** chiroyli favvora bor.

sentences.text: My parents left the city and now live **in the country**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam shahardan ko'chib, hozir **qishloq joyda** yashashadi.

sentences.text: James looked at himself **in the mirror** and smiled.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **ko'zguda** o'zini ko'rib jilmaydi.

sentences.text: What did Madina write **in** her message?
sentences.translation: Madina **xabarida** nima yozibdi?

sentences.text: There's a mistake **in** the second sentence of your essay.
sentences.translation: Inshongizning ikkinchi **gapida** xato bor.

sentences.text: The phone rang **in the middle of** the night, and everybody woke up.
sentences.translation: Tun **yarmida** telefon jiringladi va hamma uyg'onib ketdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: Where are you now?
examples.description: Telefondagi suhbat: turg'un iboralar bir vaziyatda — at work, on the bus, at the station, at home, at Bekzod's, on the way.

sentences.text: — Hi, Madina! Where are you? Are you still **at work**?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Madina! Qayerdasan? Hali ham **ishda**misan?

sentences.text: — No, I left an hour ago. I'm **on the bus** now.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, bir soat oldin chiqdim. Hozir **avtobusdaman**.

sentences.text: — Great. Can you meet me **at the station** at seven? My train's a bit late.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Soat yettida meni **vokzalda** kutib ololasanmi? Poyezdim biroz kechikyapti.

sentences.text: — Sure. Is your sister travelling **on the same train**?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Opang ham **o'sha poyezdda** kelyaptimi?

sentences.text: — No, she's staying **at home** tonight — she's got a bad cold.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, u bugun **uyda** qoladi — qattiq shamollab qolgan.

sentences.text: — Poor thing. So are we having dinner **at** Bekzod's later?
sentences.translation: — Bechora. Keyin **Bekzodlarnikida** kechki ovqat qilamizmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, his flat is **on the top floor** of that new building near the park.
sentences.translation: — Ha, uning kvartirasi park yaqinidagi o'sha yangi binoning **eng yuqori qavatida**.

sentences.text: — I know it. I'll buy a cake **on the way**.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. **Yo'lda** tort olib kelaman.

sentences.text: — Lovely. I'll wait for you **at the main entrance**, not **on the platform**.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Seni **perronda** emas, asosiy **kirish oldida** kutaman.

sentences.text: — Fine. If I'm late, wait **in the café** at the station — it's warm there.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Kechiksam, vokzaldagi **kafeda** kut — u yer iliq.
